subject: Partial regional eviction — availability impact on eu-west-2
messages:
From: Samira Rahman <samira@bluehaven.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: support@bluehaven.com
Date: 2028-09-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Partial regional eviction — availability impact on eu-west-2

Hi Irene,

We observed a sharp spike in 503s and connection failures for our EU traffic starting ~09:03 UTC this morning. The errors appear to correlate with a routing shift away from eu-west-2; about 90% of affected requests returned 503 over a ~15min window before behaviour returned to normal. This impacted a number of our checkout endpoints and caused payment retries for ~3% of our traffic.

We need Redwood to: 
- Confirm whether there was a regional eviction or capacity rebalancing that would have caused an availability gap in eu-west-2.
- Provide the official service availability window (start/end) you will use for SLA assessment.
- Provide the raw traces and request IDs for the window (we can attach a few examples).
- Confirm next steps for credit eligibility and timing for a postmortem.

Attaching a short file with sample request IDs we captured (sample-request-ids.txt). Please let us know if you need anything else from our side to validate an SLA claim — our compliance team is waiting for the timeline for an external audit.

Thanks,
Samira Rahman
Head of Site Reliability
Bluehaven Payments


From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Rahman <samira@bluehaven.com>
Cc: support@bluehaven.com
Date: 2028-09-29T09:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Partial regional eviction — availability impact on eu-west-2

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for the sample IDs. I’m opening an incident ticket and pulling the traces now. Preliminary notes: we saw an autoscaler-triggered shard rebalance in eu-west-2 at ~09:02 UTC which caused a subset of host handoffs to degrade briefly while caches warmed; I’ll confirm whether that rose to a region-level eviction.

To make sure we cover what your compliance team needs, please confirm:
- Are the attached IDs a representative sample (yes/no)?
- Do you want the raw trace bundle + redacted headers, or a filtered traceset limited to the provided IDs?

What we’ll provide in the initial package (by EOD): 
- Confirmed availability window we’re using for SLA calc.
- Raw trace bundle (redacted PI) and host-level metrics for the window.
- Preliminary impact summary and our proposed credit calculation per the SLA terms.

I’m escalating to SRE and the SLA review team and will loop internal folks for a log pull.

Irene Choi
Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-29T10:10:00Z
Subject: FW: Partial regional eviction — availability impact on eu-west-2

Team — forwarding Bluehaven’s claim. Summary and asks:
- Bluehaven reports a 503 spike impacting eu-west-2 from ~09:03–09:18 UTC. They’ve provided sample request IDs (attached) and want an SLA window + credit eligibility by EOD.
- I see an autoscaler-driven shard rebalance at 09:02 UTC in the control plane logs; cache re-warm took ~10–12 minutes on affected hosts. Need SRE to confirm: does this count as a regional eviction under our SLA wording (region-level capacity change vs per-host transient)?

Action items: 
- Karthik: pull host-level health events and eviction markers for eu-west-2 from 08:50–09:30 UTC and produce a candidate outage window. Put raw host logs into /shared/bluehaven/20280929/host-logs.tar.gz.
- Soojin: assemble traces filtered to the Bluehaven sample IDs and generate latency/FNR histograms for the window. Include KV cache hit rate during 08:50–09:30.
- Marcus: run the preliminary credit calc per contract DH-4931; flag any exceptions tied to customer-configurable routing policies.

We need a short, evidence-backed statement for Bluehaven and a piece of redacted raw traces for audit. If the window exceeds 5 minutes of region-level unavailability, they are likely eligible per our SLA. Let’s aim to have a consolidated package at 14:30 UTC so I can brief Samira before their EOD.

Irene

From: Samira Rahman <samira@bluehaven.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: support@bluehaven.com
Date: 2028-09-29T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Partial regional eviction — availability impact on eu-west-2

Thanks, Irene — attaching the sample IDs we referenced; yes, the IDs in sample-request-ids.txt are representative of the broader failure.

For audit purposes we need the raw trace bundle and your confirmed start/end window. A few clarifications:
- Our downstream PCI audit expects the raw traces redacted for cardholder data, but including full request headers/latency/path, so please keep the original timestamps.
- If you identify any routing policy we could use to reduce exposure during future rebalances (e.g., prefer-hot-hosts flag), include suggested config changes in the postmortem.

We appreciate the rapid triage. Please send the ﬁrst evidence bundle and the candidate outage window as soon as available — our compliance folks are on a tight timeline.

Samira
